summary.text: Thomas Loecken is an independent candidate for Kentucky's 2nd Congressional District. No 2026 campaign website or statements were found; the only issue material found is a 2018 newspaper questionnaire from a candidate of the same name who ran as an independent for this seat.

paragraphs.text: Ran as an independent candidate for Kentucky's 2nd District in 2018 against Guthrie and Democrat Hank Linderman; in a local newspaper questionnaire he named climate change as the most important issue facing the district.

sources.title: Candidate comparison: Guthrie faces two challengers for Kentucky’s 2nd District
